director.text: Namaste Riya! Main Asha, tumhari AI teacher. Aaj fractions ko number line par cricket pitch ki tarah dekhenge. Tumhe cricket mein kya pasand hai?
haan, samajh aaya

Cricket pitch ko ek number line socho: ek stump 0 par hai aur doosra stump 1 par. Batsman run ke liye bhaaga aur theek beech mein ruk gaya. Woh pitch ke ek pakke spot par khada hai, aur us spot ka bhi ek number hota hai.
haan samajh gayi
Screen par 0 se 1 ki line hai, aur theek beech mein ek mark. Yeh mark 0 se 1 ko 2 barabar gaps mein baant raha hai, aur is mark ka naam 1/2 hai. Yahan tak theek hai?
kal maine cricket khela, sixer maara
Cricket wali baat par is question ke turant baad wapas aayenge. Zoya ka kehna hai ki 1/3, 3 ke paas aata hai. 1/3 kahaan hai: isi 0 se 1 wali line par, ya 3 ke paas?

mujhe nahi pata

director.text: isi line par

Bilkul sahi, kyunki 1/3 ka matlab 0 se 1 ke 3 barabar gaps mein se pehla gap, toh woh isi line par hai. Screen par wahi 0 se 1 ki line hai, aur line ke upar ab beech mein 3 marks hain. Marks nahi, gaps dekho: 4 barabar gaps hain, isliye 0 ke baad pehla mark 1/4 hai. Isi line ke neeche ki taraf beech mein 7 marks hain. Yahan tak theek hai?
pata nahi, aap batao

Marks mat gino, gaps gino. Line ke upar 3 marks se 4 barabar gaps bante hain. Isi line ke neeche ki taraf 0 aur 1 ke beech 7 marks barabar doori par hain. Neeche ki taraf line kitne barabar gaps mein bati hai?

director.text: Abhi yeh sahi nahi hai. Iska jawab 1/10 hai, kyunki 10 barabar gaps ka har gap 5 gaps wale gap se chhota hai, toh 1/10, 0 ke zyada paas rukta hai. Ghar 0 par hai aur school 1 km par. Ghar aur school ke beech raaste mein 3 bijli ke khambe barabar doori par lage hain. Pehla khamba ghar se kitne km door hai? Diya hai: ghar 0 par aur school 1 km par hai, aur beech mein 3 khambe barabar doori par hain. Dhoondhna hai: pehle khambe ki ghar se doori, km mein. Ab agla kadam dekhte hain.
haan
Pehla kadam dekho. Rekha banao aur ghar ko 0 par, school ko 1 par likho: 0 se 1 tak ki rekha, kyunki 0 se 1 tak ka poora raasta hi humara ek poora hai. Yahan tak theek hai?
mujhe lagta hai haan
Ab doosra kadam. Khambe nahi, beech ke gaps gino: 3 khambe, toh 4 barabar hisse, kyunki beech ke nishaan se gaps hamesha ek zyada hote hain. Chalo, aage dekhte hain.
haan
Raasta 4 barabar gaps mein bata hai, aur pehla khamba ghar se theek ek gap door hai. Toh pehla khamba kitne km par hai?

Haan, sahi hai, kyunki 1/2 ek poore ka aadha hai, toh woh 0 aur 1 ke beech aata hai. Ab tak humne 0 se sirf ek gap liya, jaise 1/4. Agle hisse mein 0 se 2 ya 3 gap chalenge, aur upar ka number batayega ki kitne gap chalna hai. Ab aage chalte hain.

Theek hai, koi baat nahi. Hum aage chal sakte hain, thoda break le sakte hain, ya aaj ke liye stop kar sakte hain. Tum batao.
